📝 Walkthrough ## Walkthrough The lifecycle tooling now supports an opt-in read-only SolidWorks interruption qualification. It validates pinned fixture copies, inspects geometry and identity, interrupts an owned native process, records immutable evidence, and verifies recovery in a fresh process. ### Changes **Read-only interruption qualification** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Fixture inspection and geometry validation**
`scripts/native/session-lifecycle/PreparedCylinder.cs`|Adds read-only fixture validation for file identity, document state, configuration, dependencies, extrusion structure, geometry, mass properties, rebuild status, and COM cleanup.| |**Native fixture probe modes**
`scripts/native/session-lifecycle/NativeSessionProbe.cs`|Adds `fixture-open`, `fixture-inspect`, and `fixture-close` modes. The probe records inspection reports and validates final document counts.| |**Interruption and recovery orchestration**
`scripts/native/session-lifecycle/InterruptionCase.ps1`|Creates private attempts and immutable evidence, starts the fixture probe, interrupts the retained process, verifies preservation, and runs a fresh recovery attempt.| |**Lifecycle dispatch and qualification records**
`scripts/native/session-lifecycle/lifecycle.ps1`, `scripts/native/session-lifecycle/README.md`, `docs/solidworks-2022-feasibility.md`|Adds opt-in parameters, input validation, source staging, native process helpers, interruption dispatch, receipts, workflow documentation, and qualification limits.| **Priority:** ⬇️ Low **Estimated code review effort:** 4 (Complex) | ~45 minutes **Merge Risk:** _⚪ Minimal_ · up to `4216c` This adds an explicitly opted-in, read-only interruption and fresh-session recovery qualification for pinned SolidWorks fixtures. The flow validates private fixture copies and process identity before interruption, with no current merge-blocking risk identified. ### Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Lifecycle participant InterruptionCase participant NativeSessionProbe participant SolidWorks Lifecycle->>InterruptionCase: prepare private fixture attempts InterruptionCase->>NativeSessionProbe: start fixture inspection NativeSessionProbe->>SolidWorks: open and validate read-only fixture SolidWorks-->>InterruptionCase: inspection evidence InterruptionCase->>SolidWorks: interrupt retained native process InterruptionCase->>NativeSessionProbe: start fresh recovery inspection NativeSessionProbe->>SolidWorks: validate recovery fixture SolidWorks-->>Lifecycle: persist recovery result ```
